paragraphs: Edupoint makes a student data management product for the K-12 market, aimed at personalized learning and informed decision-making. The company says it is 100% focused on K-12 student data management.

The pitch rests on one record set, with no data silos and no need to enter data more than once. Teachers work from a single place for attendance, assignments, course content, grading, quizzes and tests, and interventions. Parents and students get real-time mobile access. Around the core system sit modules for collaborative IEP and special education management. Another covers tiered intervention and positive behavior management. An analytics module brings district data together and visualizes it in one place.

Edupoint reports 5.5 million students in 21 states. Bob Weathers founded the company in 2003. Recent announcements list districts switching over, among them Port Chester Public Schools in New York, replacing eSchoolPlus. The company was also named one of the top companies to work for in Arizona in 2026.
